reallocation.executive_summary: By cutting the unprofitable Hydrating Cleanser and reducing the stockout-risk Retinol campaign, we free $290 per day to reinvest in the portfolio's two highest-margin products. experiment.opportunity_rationale: Starter Bundle receives the largest budget increase in the reallocation plan, has the highest true profit ROAS, and low return rates — making it the ideal candidate to optimise creative for even higher conversion.
experiment.hypothesis: If we add customer review social proof to the ad headline, then click-through rate will increase by 15% and conversion rate will increase by 8% because purchase decisions for skincare bundles are heavily influenced by peer validation.
experiment.control_description: Current ad creative with product-feature-led headline and standard call-to-action.
experiment.variant_description: New ad creative with top customer review quote in headline and trust-signal badge ('4.8★ from 2,400 reviews') in description.
experiment.risk_assessment: Low risk — variant is additive copy change with no pricing or landing-page modification.
